title: World situation monitor
description: A global view of reported earthquakes and NASA headlines. Inspect original evidence, timestamps and source status; the feeds are external observations, not simulated physical truth. Add or replace sources in the editor or during a Run.
objectives: Explore reports worldwide, inspect their provenance and distinguish missing coverage from an absence of events.
Ask the companion assistant for a sourced briefing of retained records. It cannot watch linked video or infer unreported locations.
